# REQ: LANG-1061 LANG-1062 LANG-1063 LANG-1064 /* Web server class. */ class webserver ( String $docroot = '/var/www', Integer $port = 8080, Boolean $enabled = true, ) inherits webserver::params { package { 'nginx': ensure => installed, } file { "${docroot}/index.html": ensure => file, content => "Hello from $facts['hostname'] on port ${port}\n", mode => '0644', require => Package['nginx'], } if $enabled and $port > 1024 { service { 'nginx': ensure => running } } else { notice('disabled') } } node 'web01.example.com' { include webserver }
